objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Lately I’ve been feeling persistent fatigue and my sleep quality has been poor. Over the last month I’ve lost weight without trying, and I’ve also noticed jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing a sudden and strong need to urinate, even when your bladder isn't completely full?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed a sudden or urgent need to urinate, and I don’t think it’s happening even when my bladder isn’t full.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or areas of thickening in your breast tissue, perhaps something that feels different from the rest of your breast?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or thickened areas—nothing feels different from the rest. My main issues are still the persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small, firm bumps on my skin that feel smooth to the touch.”

turns.doctor_question: been reviewing your symptoms, and I want to ask: Have you been feeling like you just can't seem to cool down or catch your breath, even when you're in a cool environment or not exerting yourself much
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt like I can’t cool down, and I haven’t had trouble catching my breath when I’m in a cool environment or not exerting myself.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t feel unusually stressed or anxious day to day, but I’ve just been worn out with persistent fatigue and my sleep has been poor. I can’t say it feels linked to stress—I’m mainly concerned about the ongoing tiredness, my unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation that makes you want to scratch, either on specific areas of your body or all over?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed itching or any urge to scratch, either all over or in specific areas. My main concerns remain the persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms. I mainly just feel persistently tired, my sleep has been poor, and I’ve had unintentional weight loss along with the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that it's been harder to find the right words when you're talking lately? Sometimes people have trouble coming up with the words they want to say. Is that something you've been experiencing?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble finding the right words or been struggling to speak. I’m just mostly dealing with persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, like it's hard to move or relax certain parts of your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in my muscles, and I don’t feel it’s hard to move or relax specific parts of my body. It’s mainly just the persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”

turns.doctor_question: How's your energy level been today? Have you felt unusually sleepy or struggled to stay awake, even when you're doing things you normally enjoy or when you're in a situation where you need to be alert?
turns.patient_answer: “I’d say my energy is low most days—I feel unusually sleepy and worn out, and even normal activities don’t feel as engaging. I can stay awake, but it takes more effort than it used to. The persistent fatigue and poor sleep are really what’s driving it.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel that one or both of your legs are unusually warm right now, or do they feel about the same temperature as the rest of your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, my legs don’t feel unusually warm right now—they feel about the same temperature as the rest of my body. The main thing I’m noticing is still persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the jaundice.”
